{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

::: remark

A function can be written down as an expression and computed by an algorithm.
This page defines expressions, which write down the [functions](functions.qmd)
in the Morrison Lab's probability and statistics notes,
the parse trees of expressions, and algorithms, which compute those functions.

:::
